AAATenderGuy/Lightweight-AI-Tutoring-Per.body:
# Edu · Lightweight AI Teaching Service

Merges **DeepTutor**'s personalized tutoring and mastery tracking with **OpenMAIC**'s classroom generation and interaction into a single-process **Python + Vue3** application.

Student side: upload lecture notes → ask the AI tutor questions (with sources) → generate an interactive classroom with one click → in-class quizzes → see the mastery level of each knowledge point.
Teacher side: log in → create a class → issue invitation codes → assign in-class quizzes and homework → view submission progress and the distribution of wrong answers → export student reports.

No separate database service, no vector store, and no standalone frontend server are needed. Double-click `start.bat` to use it
(data is stored in a single `data/edu.sqlite3` file).

| Capability | Source | Implementation in Edu |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Socratic one-on-one tutoring | DeepTutor | `/api/chat/stream`, gives hints first and then follow-up questions; supports "guided" and "explanation" modes |
| Material retrieval and source citation | DeepTutor | After upload, lecture notes are chunked and indexed; hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval (RRF fusion, optional LLM reranking); answers cite sources with `[1]` and give paragraph numbers |

# FoxDesk

A local Camoufox fingerprint browser manager — free, open source, privacy-first.

**Current version: `1.6.0` (Stable)**

## Features

- **Dual engine** — choose per profile between Camoufox (Firefox) or Chromium (Playwright/Patchright; auto prefers Patchright)
- **Profile management** — create, edit, clone, import/export, tag grouping
- **Fingerprint control** — parameter editing + random generation + running probe reports + static consistency scoring
- **Session control** — start/stop/logs, **live navigation**, concurrency limit, auto-stop on idle
- **Server mode** — capture `ws_endpoint` where possible, for external Playwright connections
- **Proxy pool** — health checks; sticky/round-robin/random health-based allocation; passwords encrypted with DPAPI
- **Cookie management** — export as SQLite cookies; import JSON / Netscape, injected on next launch
- **Scenario templates** — clean / e-commerce / automation / social media / research / mobile window, etc.
- **Proxy environment matching** — exit IP ownership detection (residential/datacenter), one-click matching of timezone/language, batch application of environment settings
- **Local backup** — password-encrypted `.fdk` export/restore (automatic snapshot before restore)
- **In-app updates** — GitHub Release + **ghproxy** + optional token + SHA256
- **Diagnostic export** — one-click export of a redacted diagnostic bundle from the System page
- **Local API token** — UI injects `X-FoxDesk-Token`
- **First-run onboarding / tray / bilingual / installers**

# Vibe Mathematics — Multi-Agent Mathematical Problem Solving and Verification Framework (Four Architectures)

[English](https://github.com/ChongCyrus/Vibe-Mathematics/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | Chinese

> A set of **agent presets** (`vibe-math-v2` / `vibe-math-v3` / `vibe-math-v4` / `vibe-math-v5`) running inside the **DeepSeek Harness**. They use multi-agent collaboration to automatically solve mathematical problems and cross-verify conclusions across agents. The four presets share the foundational capabilities of '**checkpoint resumption**, **mid-run human intervention**, **progress reporting**, and **natural-language driving**', but use four generations of different solving architectures:
> **💡 v4/v5 first**: `vibe-math-v4` (the 'persistent self-organizing collaborative research' architecture) and `vibe-math-v5` (the latest 'research institute system') are the **current primary maintenance direction**. `vibe-math-v2` and `vibe-math-v3` are **classic/early architectures** that have **matured and been finalized**; going forward they receive only **compatibility adaptation** maintenance (new capabilities go only into v4/v5). All four sets ship with the package and work normally; see [`docs/maintenance-policy.md`](https://github.com/ChongCyrus/Vibe-Mathematics/blob/HEAD/docs/maintenance-policy.md) for details. Choose based on your actual needs (see 'How to choose' below).
>
> - **`vibe-math-v2` (probability-driven · JSON data layer) · classic**: `qs.json` problem list + `Propos/` proposition library + probability-driven scheduling + code-heuristic scheduling;
> - **`vibe-math-v3` (third generation · paper-style md + planning agent + method library) · classic**: all knowledge is stored and continued as **Markdown paper/research-report style** (`Problems/` problem list + dependencies + source motivation, `Progress/` research log, `Propos/` proposition library, `Methods/` general theory invention library, `Verified/` absolutely trusted); before scheduling, a **planning agent** autonomously drafts the next N steps of a plan; theories, frameworks, tools, methods, and ideas invented during problem solving are consolidated by the **Method Keeper** into a reusable method system (as with inventing group theory or functional analysis);

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

# ⚙️ Environment Setup

### 1. Set up bun

Development requires [**bun version 1.2.2 or later**](https://bun.sh/). Install it according to your environment.

```bash
# Linux / macOS / WSL2
curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
```

For Windows, use the following.

```powershell
powershell -c "irm bun.sh/install.ps1|iex"
# or
winget search --id  Oven-sh.Bun
```

### 2. Set up your editor

[Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) is the recommended editor. Also install the [recommended extensions](https://github.com/aipictors/aipictors/blob/HEAD/.vscode/extensions.json).

You can also install the extensions all at once with the following command.

```bash
bun run init:vscode
```

If the `code` command is not installed, open the command palette in VSCode and run the following.

```
> Shell Command: Install 'code' command in PATH
```

You can open the command palette with the following shortcut.

```
shift + command + P
```

If you are asked to reload, restart VSCode.
For Visual Studio Code settings, see [settings.json](https://github.com/aipictors/aipictors/blob/HEAD/.vscode/settings.json).

### 3. Start the development environment

1. Install dependencies

```bash
bun i
```

3. Start the development server.

```bash
bun run dev
```

### 3. Access the app

You can access it at [localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000).

### 3. Before committing

Run the following to confirm that no build errors occur.

```bash
bun run check
```

chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.body:
# ⚽ Football Signal Radar · Daily Signal Report

> **Set emotions aside and watch only the signals.**
> Three-channel cross-validation of market movements: no bets on low odds, no bets when signals are unclear. Automatically executed before matches, automatically settled after.

## 🚀 Online Site

- **[https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/](https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/)**
- Updated automatically every hour, historical dates archived, available to review anytime
- Covers **500~1300+** matches per day (full Jingcai/Asian handicap coverage), automatically flags signals and bets

---

## The Detours We Bypassed

We tried **models**: stacked parameters until the room was full. Looking back, the model only recited prices the market had already set. No matter how many parameters, it couldn't produce anything new.

We tried **studying the bookmakers**: guessing at the bookmakers' moves, the more we guessed, the more it looked like paranoid delusion. In the end I realized: guessing the bookmaker is less useful than watching the price.

We also tried **AI predictions**: injuries, team motivation, form. Each one sounded convincing, and each had already been priced into the odds long before. However lively the talk, the market doesn't buy it.

After the detours, one plain principle remains:

> **Where the money flows, the market speaks.**
> But people watching the market get carried away easily: chasing favorites, fearing underdogs, shaky hands at the last minute. You can tell at a glance when emotion is doing the trading.

So we hand both "watching" and "buying" to the machine, and keep only one thing for the human: **discipline**.

## Three Informants, One Referee

**1X2 (European odds)** tracks market-wide odds movements: who is being collectively abandoned, who is quietly defending, whether the draw line has been given up. This is the informant closest to the action.

**Asian handicap** tracks the line and water (odds): sudden pivots near kickoff, sniping on the favored side. Money was thrown down with real cash, which is more honest than what people say.

**Over/Under** tracks the total goals line: when a breeding ground for goals appears, the number of goals in the match has often already been foretold.

Each of the three informants has its own news. When the news agrees, the referee dares to make the call. **Matches where they disagree (European odds and Asian handicap contradicting each other) are simply not touched.** When the informants themselves are arguing, why bet at all?

## Discipline Matters More Than Vision

Once the direction is set, everything else is discipline:

- **No bets on low odds**: single-option odds under 1.5, or double-option odds that discount below 1.3, no matter how good the signal. At odds that low, even a win doesn't earn real money.
- **No bets on unclear signals**: no signal, conflicting signals, or an ambiguous direction means always wait. Missing a bet doesn't lose money; betting wrong does.
- **Quality determines stake size**: the firmer the signal, the larger the stake (1/2/4 units). No all-in gambling.
- **Automatic betting 15 minutes before kickoff, automatic settlement when results arrive**: no shaky hands during play, no urge to add stakes after winning or chase losses after losing.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is for data research only and does not constitute any purchase advice. Buy lottery tickets only at licensed physical retail outlets. Anyone under 18 years old may not participate.

danything/denpa.body:
# denpa

The documentation is also available at **[danything.github.io/denpa](https://danything.github.io/denpa/)**.

**A home TV recording server that's ready to use as soon as you plug in a tuner and start it.**
No configuration files are needed. The tuner type (terrestrial / satellite) is detected automatically, and you just press Scan on the screen.
Mirakurun, EDCB, and media servers are not required. You can reserve recordings from the program guide, commercials are skipped automatically,
and both live and recorded content can be watched in the browser with subtitles and data broadcasting. For TV, use the dedicated app [denpa-tv](https://github.com/danything/denpa-tv).

If you're upgrading from 1.x, first read [what changed in 2.0](https://github.com/danything/denpa/blob/HEAD/docs/v2.md) (screen locations and removed settings).

For the other screens (program guide, clips, search, rules, settings), see [docs/screens.md](https://github.com/danything/denpa/blob/HEAD/docs/screens.md).

## Scope of use

denpa is intended for recording and watching **with your own B-CAS card, within your own household, for private use**.

- Do not let anyone outside your household watch recordings or live streams
- Do not distribute the card's keys to devices outside your household
- Do not rewrite the card

The client (browser) connects directly to outside services only for live commentary, and only when that is turned on in settings. It connects to NX-Jikkyo and the Niconico Jikkyo past-log API. Those services can see the client's IP address and which channel is being watched and when ([docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/danything/denpa/blob/HEAD/docs/architecture.md#端末が外へ繋ぐもの-実況のコメント)).
In live view you can post comments to NX-Jikkyo. Posts are public and cannot be deleted ([docs/watch.md](https://github.com/danything/denpa/blob/HEAD/docs/watch.md#実況に書き込む)).

The reasoning behind this is summarized in [Discussion #760](https://github.com/danything/denpa/discussions/760). It is an organized basis for discussion, not legal advice.

- **Reservations**: press a button in the program guide, or let rules created from search make reservations automatically. The same episode is recorded only from its first broadcast.

# ShuangxiuGo (双休购)

Turning the KPIs your boss uses to evaluate you into a currency vote that workers can use to evaluate the boss.

> **Project positioning: this repository is the main site of ShuangxiuGo (双休购), a live application deployed on GitHub Pages.** Please distinguish it from the two other ShuangxiuGo-related repositories under this account:
>
> - **shuangxiugou-guide** ([repository](https://github.com/dujeongil-galaxy/shuangxiugou-guide)) → a complete, **purely static backup** of the public information site "ShuangxiuGo 2.0" ([live](https://dujeongil-galaxy.github.io/shuangxiugou-guide/)), covering 246 company/brand leads (research baseline date 2026-09-09). > - **shuangxiu-go-archive** ([repository](https://github.com/dujeongil-galaxy/shuangxiu-go-archive)) → a complete static archive backup of the third-party website "ShuangxiuGO" (shuangxiu-go.cn), unrelated to this main site's data.
>
> **Relationship between the data of the two sites**: the 246 entries on the guide site are **research leads**, classified by strength of evidence into five tiers: A publicly confirmed / B media reported / C aggregated candidates / risk warnings / rest schedule pending verification. Most of them have not yet obtained primary evidence. This main site only includes entries whose evidence chain is complete and sufficient to support rating conclusions; the rest remain on the guide site as material awaiting verification. Therefore, the different entry counts on the two sites are expected and are not a data conflict.
>
> **Inclusion principles of the main site** (the sole standard; not relaxed due to brand recognition, scale, or public-opinion heat):
>
> 1. **Objective and neutral** — present only publicly verifiable information, without mixing in personal likes or dislikes;
> 2. **No emotional wording** — describe rest schedules and overtime based on facts, avoiding positive or negative coloring and emotionally charged language;
> 3. **Do not avoid judgment when the evidence chain is incomplete** — on 2026-10-31 the site owner corrected the record: the U-tier (pending verification · not rated) is restored as a valid tier, but **it must be accompanied by an "evidence missing statement" (hard rule, written below under "U-tier hard rules")**; where evidence allows a judgment, a judgment is still made without avoidance. **Ratings depend only on the number of monthly rest days; a two-day weekend is not required to fall on Saturday and Sunday.** B tier = 6–8 rest days per month; A tier = more than 8 rest days per month; S tier = A tier + actual two-day-weekend rate meets the standard; C tier = fewer than 6 rest days per month, or refusal to disclose. lujih/webnovel-writer-opencode.body:
# Webnovel Writer for OpenCode — AI Long-Form Web Novel Creation System

## 1. Introduction

In the wave of AI-assisted writing, an excellent creation system is like a lighthouse, guiding authors to keep their sense of direction and consistency through a long serialized journey. As Antoine de Saint-Exupéry wrote in *The Little Prince*: "One can only see rightly with the heart. The true essence of things is invisible to the naked eye."

### 1.1 Why We Need This Project

The core challenge of long-form web novel writing is not "writing one chapter" but "remembering the chapter-one foreshadowing when you reach chapter two hundred." Traditional AI writing tools face three fundamental dilemmas:

| Dilemma | Manifestation | This Project's Response |
|---------|---------------|-------------------------|
| **Forgetting** | AI forgets earlier settings, character relationships, and planted foreshadowing | 3-layer RAG context + story contract engine + SSOT event sourcing (foreshadowing / entities / world rules all projected) |
| **Hallucination** | AI fabricates settings out of thin air and contradicts itself | Graph-RAG entity relationship graph + Code Checker hard-constraint blocking |
| **Style drift** | Over a long serialization, writing style gradually departs from the initial setting | MASTER_SETTING contract + OOC reviewer + genre template constraints |

In *Code Complete*, Steve McConnell emphasizes: "Good documentation helps developers avoid many unnecessary errors and confusions, and improves work efficiency." For AI writing, "documentation" means the setting bible, outlines, and story contracts. They are the key to ensuring that AI still follows the initial settings after 200 chapters.

### 1.2 Main Components of the Project

A complete AI writing system is like a professional editorial team, where each module has its own role:

| Component | Role | Analogy |
|-----------|------|---------|
| **Story contract engine** | Maintains the "legal system" of world rules | Editor-in-chief |
| **Context management** | Assembles the most relevant settings and foreshadowing for each chapter | Managing editor |
| **Layered review** | Structured checking of chapter quality across 6 dimensions | Proofreading team |
| **Memory system** | Three-layer memory compression and retrieval | Archivist |
| **Knowledge base** | CSV-structured writing techniques and naming rules | Style guide |

As Fred Brooks said in *The Mythical Man-Month*: "Good documentation is key to the success of a software product." Each module of this project revolves around one core idea: **structure writing knowledge so that AI can create continuously and consistently**.

nisu123f/HonorDuoBar.body:
# Honor SystemUI Enhancement (HonorSystemUI)

An LSPosed module for the Honor / Honor system UI (`com.android.systemui`) that provides only **status bar merging**: it combines Wi-Fi, mobile signal, and battery into a single Duo-style glyph.

> This project uses AI to imitate [HyperDuo](https://github.com/yixing233/HyperDuo) and implement the status bar merging feature on Honor MagicOS 11.

---

## Feature Overview

### Status Bar

| Switch | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Status bar merging | On | Merges Wi-Fi, mobile signal, and battery into one Duo-style glyph: an outer battery ring, Wi-Fi arcs / battery percentage inside the ring, and signal dots at the bottom. The three native icons are hidden. |
| Merged: show Wi-Fi arcs | On | Draws Wi-Fi arcs in the upper part of the ring. The number of arcs follows the actual signal strength. |
| Merged: show mobile signal dots | On | Draws 4 signal dots at the bottom of the ring (single SIM, uses the default data card). |
| Merged: show battery percentage | On | Shows the battery percentage at the center of the ring. A lightning bolt is always shown while charging. |
| Merged: show 5G/4G when no Wi-Fi | On | When there is no Wi-Fi, the upper part of the ring shows the current network type text instead. |
| Merged: color accents | On | Green while charging, red when the battery is low (untested). When turned off, all elements follow the status bar's inverted color. |

### Merged Icon Size

Provides a slider from 18–26 dp, adjustable in 1 dp steps (default 20 dp). It uses fixed dp values, so it does not scale with the host row height in landscape or on the lock screen.

---

## Installation

### Prerequisites

| Item | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| System | Honor / MagicOS 11 (self-tested on MagicOS 10) |
| Framework | LSPosed supporting libxposed **API 102** |

### Steps

1. Install this module's APK.
2. Open **LSPosed Manager** → Modules → enable **Honor Duo Bar**.
3. In the scope, check **System UI (`com.android.systemui`)**.
4. Open the app and adjust the switches → tap "Restart System UI" (requires root access), or manually restart the phone.

System UI can also be restarted with this command:

```sh
adb shell "su -c 'killall com.android.systemui'"
```

> Switch changes take effect after the SystemUI process restarts.

---

## Build

This project is built with pure command-line tools, **no Gradle required**.

### Dependencies

- JDK 17+
- `kotlinc` (Kotlin compiler)

### Oracle ARM 抢注脚本 → ### Oracle ARM Instance Grabbing Script

This script is built on the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Python SDK. It automatically and repeatedly tries to grab ARM-architecture instances (`VM.Standard.A1.Flex`) from the Oracle Cloud Always Free tier. It supports automatic parsing of the `main.tf` configuration file, smart backoff retries, network fault tolerance, and Telegram notification push.

> Only key-based login is supported. If you need password-based login, modify `oracle_arm.py` yourself.

## Pre-run Preparation

### 1. Create a `data` folder, edit the `.env` and `config` files, and save your private key `p.pem` inside the `data` folder

#### Save the `.env` file with the following format

```bash
USE_TG=True
TG_BOT_TOKEN=123456789:ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
TG_USER_ID=987654321
TG_API_HOST=api.telegram.org
```

- `USE_TG=True` enables Telegram notifications. If you don't need them, change `True` to `False` and check the logs yourself for details.
- `TG_BOT_TOKEN`: enter the Telegram bot TOKEN.
- `TG_USER_ID`: enter the user, channel, or group ID.
- `TG_API_HOST`: enter the address of a self-hosted Telegram API reverse proxy, for use when the network cannot reach the default host. Keep the default if your network is working normally.

#### Save the `config` file with the following format

```bash
[DEFAULT]
user=ocid1.user.oc1..aaaaaaxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
fingerprint=xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx
key_file=/opt/oci/p.pem
tenancy=ocid1.tenancy.oc1..aaaaaaaxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
region=us-ashburn-1
```

- For the values of `user`, `fingerprint`, `tenancy`, and `region`, refer to the [Oracle official documentation](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/sdkconfig.htm#SDK_and_CLI_Configuration_File#ariaid-title3).

# ConfigFlow

**Manage proxy subscriptions, internet rules, and network devices from one web page.**

ConfigFlow organizes subscriptions and nodes into configurations usable by Mihomo, Surge, Loon, MosDNS, and OxiDNS. It can also send configurations to devices and view their running status. Proxy subscriptions or nodes must be prepared by you.

[User Manual](https://thsrite.github.io/configflow/) · [Docker Image](https://hub.docker.com/r/thsrite/config-flow) · [Report an Issue](https://github.com/thsrite/configflow/issues)

## What It Can Do

- Organize subscriptions and nodes, check connectivity, and schedule automatic updates.
- Set internet rules for websites and devices, and generate configurations for phones, computers, or routers.
- Manage services on Linux, Docker, and RouterOS, send configurations, and view logs and running status.
- Configure shared DNS addresses for two OxiDNS instances, so that if one fails, the other takes over.

## Getting Started

1. [Install the management panel](https://thsrite.github.io/configflow/guide/install): choose Docker or NAS deployment, and set up an account and data storage directory.
2. [Complete the first-run wizard](https://thsrite.github.io/configflow/guide/first-run): enter your subscriptions and choose the usage method that suits you.
3. [Install and connect devices](https://thsrite.github.io/configflow/guide/agent-install): choose the installation combination for your actual devices. This step can be skipped if you only download configurations for clients to use.
4. Test one device first. Once it works normally, let other devices use it.

yamibk/Relatum.description: Open-source, local-first knowledge canvas for Windows — freeform visual notes, one-click mind maps, study tools and optional AI.
yamibk/Relatum.body:
# Relatum Open-source, local-first knowledge canvas and study notes software for Windows
Suited for visual notes, personal knowledge management (PKM), course organization, research brainstorming, and mind maps
Interface language: Simplified Chinese · English ## What is Relatum? Relatum is an open-source local Windows application that provides four workspaces: canvas, notes, research, and career. No account registration is required. Notes, canvases, and settings are saved on your computer. Core features work offline, and the AI assistant connects on demand to services configured by the user. ## Core Features ### Canvas - Add text, images, code, and attachments on an infinite canvas, and move and connect them freely. - Adjust node and connector styles; supports handwriting, one-click mind map layout, and PNG export. - Basic compatibility with the Obsidian Canvas format. ### Notes - Real-time Markdown rendering with support for formulas, code, Callouts, images, and embedded canvases. - Manage files with notebooks, folders, and multiple tabs; auto-saves while editing. - Find and browse notes via search, recent files, tags, outline, bidirectional links, and graph view. ### Reading and Materials - Read PDF and Markdown, and add annotations. - Supports formulas, Mermaid diagrams, and local attachments; Markdown folders can be imported. ### Study and Career - Provides study tasks, daily tasks, a Pomodoro timer, and a count-up timer. - Supports calendar diary, countdown days, a quick-note wall, and review cards. - The career workspace shows daily usage time, a yearly heatmap, and usage trends for each workspace, viewable by time range. ### Appearance and AI - Supports themes, custom backgrounds, templates, and style presets. - The optional AI assistant supports chat, content organization, and canvas generation; the API address, model, and key are configured by the user. ## Interface Preview ### Notes: Real-time Markdown Rendering Formulas, lists, and Callouts are displayed directly while editing; the outline on the right allows quick jumps to sections. ### Notes: Browsing and Querying Find notes via recent files, tags, and search; the list shows titles, summaries, and file paths. ### Career: Usage Statistics View daily usage time, a yearly heatmap, and workspace usage trends; supports all records, last 30 days, 90 days, this year, and custom ranges. ### Other Interfaces ## Quick Start ### Download the Windows Desktop Version 1. [Download the latest `Relatum-release.zip`](https://github.com/yamibk/Relatum/releases/latest/download/Relatum-release.zip). 2. Extract the ZIP completely into a writable directory. 3. Double-click the colored `Relatum.exe` icon to enter full mode, or double-click the black-and-white-gray `RelatumLauncher.exe` icon to choose this session's features before launching. Supports Windows 10/11. The target computer requires Microsoft Edge WebView2…

# AI Customer Service System (AIKF) > A multi-tenant AI customer service SaaS platform for general industries, using the window-curtain (soft furnishings) industry as the example scenario. > Built on large language models (DeepSeek V4 Pro + DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision) + business tools (**the count is taken from the registry as the single source of truth; see “Version source of truth” under “Tech Stack” for the recalculation command**), covering the full pipeline from pre-sales consultation to after-sales service. ## ✨ Core Highlights - **Dual-agent architecture** — C-end customer service agent 元元 + B-end work assistant 黄金策, driven by a LangGraph state graph - **AI tools** — product search, order management, logistics tracking, customer lookup, etc., with automatic intent routing (count is taken from the `registry.py` registry as the single source of truth) - **Multi-tenant SaaS** — tenant isolation (tenant_id derived from JWT → MyBatis tenant interceptor → field masking) - **Complete business back office** — products, orders, CRM, human agent workstations, dashboards, and 12+ management modules - **WeChat Mini Program** — Taro cross-platform framework, SSE streaming conversations, native-like experience - **Full-stack Alibaba Cloud deployment** — SWAS lightweight application server (CI builds the image + server pulls) + RDS + Redis (Tair) + OSS, with GitHub Actions CI/CD > ℹ️ **Knowledge base note**: The legacy RAG knowledge base (vector-retrieval document store) has been fully removed along with the LLM WIKI section (issue #3051).
